task_language: pick up the book and place it in the right compartment of the caddy

subtasks.name: pick(book)
subtasks.outcome: failed: gripper knocks the standing book over during the approach (80-100); book ends lying flat on the table and is never grasped

subtasks.name: place(book, caddy_right_compartment, in)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted with the book: pi0 performs the place motion with an empty gripper in the middle column of the caddy (200-409)

behaviour_summary: pi0 approaches the standing book, knocks it flat while descending, then goes on to the caddy with an empty gripper and repeatedly dips into the middle column until the timeout.

failures.mode_definition: The gripper contacts the object during the pre-grasp descent and knocks it over before a grasp is formed.
failures.rl_subtask: pick(book) from a standing pose and place it in the right compartment of the caddy
failures.rl_success_check: book lifted off the table and then inside the right compartment of the caddy, gripper open
failures.observation: Step 60 the open gripper is above-left of the upright book; at 80 the fingers straddle/press the book's top edge from the left; at 100 the book lies flat on the table and the gripper is empty above it.

failures.mode_definition: After a missed or failed grasp, the policy proceeds to the transport/place phase with an empty gripper instead of re-attempting the grasp.
hl_remedy: VERIFY gripper is empty and target still on the table (zoom on target ROI)
REPROMPT "pick up the book and place it in the right compartment of the caddy"
WATCH 5 s for an approach to the book (now lying flat)
retry once, then INVOKE_RL for the grasp or ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Coordinator runs a grasp VERIFY (object lifted with the gripper) before allowing the transport phase.
failures.observation: At 120 the gripper is above the fallen book; at 140 it is moving to the caddy with nothing in hand; 180-409 it goes down into the middle column of the caddy and back up repeatedly with an empty, closed gripper.

notes: The empty-handed place goes to the middle column, not the right compartment (image-left tall cell), consistent with the other STUDY_SCENE2 episodes ignoring the compartment qualifier. After the knock-over the book lies flat, which would require a different grasp than the original standing pose.
